violated_contract: A parser that branches on isinstance(x, (int, float)) must exclude bool first: bool subclasses int, so a boolean flag converts to 1.0/0.0 and masquerades as a real value instead of failing closed as unparseable.
canonical_prevention: Reject bool explicitly before the numeric branch and return the unparseable sentinel (None); cover True and False in a regression test alongside unchanged int/float/str/None behavior.
